issue.title: [autoneg]When advertise interface type is set, disabling AN, setting interface type and re-enabling autoneg will lead to port oper down

failure.body:
#### Description
Since the interface type is set only when AN is enabled as seen [here](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-swss/blob/a01470f8eb210bdab462cdcaefc3471a9f8f9d0b/orchagent/portsorch.cpp#L3587
) it leads to stale configs present when AN is re-enabled. With mismatching interface type vs advertised interface types vendor SAI can throw errors as shown below.

```

Jan 15 <IPV6>.508856 r-bulldog-02 ERR syncd#SDK: [SAI_PORT.ERR] mlnx_sai_port.c[3087]- mlnx_port_update_speed: Failed to merge speeds, interface types and auto_neg.
Jan 15 <IPV6>.508856 r-bulldog-02 ERR syncd#SDK: [SAI_PORT.ERR] mlnx_sai_port.c[2595]- mlnx_port_attr_set: Failed to update speed.
Jan 15 <IPV6>.508898 r-bulldog-02 ERR syncd#SDK: [SAI_UTILS.ERR] mlnx_sai_utils.c[2036]- sai_set_attribute: Failed set attrib dispatch

Jan 15 <IPV6>.509532 r-bulldog-02 INFO syncd#SDK: :- sendApiResponse: response for SAI_COMMON_API_SET api was send
Jan 15 <IPV6>.509532 r-bulldog-02 ERR syncd#SDK: :- processQuadEvent: VID: oid:0x1000000000278 RID: oid:0x1003900000001
Jan 15 <IPV6>.509532 r-bulldog-02 ERR syncd#SDK: :- processQuadEvent: attr: SAI_PORT_ATTR_AUTO_NEG_MODE: true
Jan 15 <IPV6>.510223 r-bulldog-02 ERR swss#orchagent: :- set: set status: SAI_STATUS_INVALID_ATTR_VALUE_0
Jan 15 <IPV6>.510223 r-bulldog-02 ERR swss#orchagent: :- setPortAutoNeg: Failed to set AutoNeg 1 to port pid:1000000000278

Jan 15 <IPV6>.510223 r-bulldog-02 ERR swss#orchagent: :- doPortTask: Failed to set port Ethernet60 AN from 0 to 1
Jan 15 <IPV6>.512442 r-bulldog-02 INFO syncd#SDK: :- processSingleEvent: key: SAI_OBJECT_TYPE_PORT:oid:0x1000000000278 op: set
```

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. Configure autoneg, interface type and advertise interface type
2. Disable Autoneg.
3.  Modify interface type, advertise interface type
4. Enable autoneg

#### Describe the results you received:
Enable autoneg throws error in syslog and not reflected in ASIC_DB. Port is in down state

#### Describe the results you expected:
Autoneg should succeed.

resolution.title: [autoneg]Fixing adv interface types to be set when AN is disabled
resolution.description:
**What I did**
Allowing advertised interface types to be set even when AN is disabled. The SAI header doesn't restrict this field. In some cases when this field is changed during AN disable, it may not be reflected in SAI leading to errors as seen in the issue below. This will occur when interface type mismatches with advertise interface type and the vendor SAI library has checks.

**Why I did it**
To fix https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/13414

**How I verified it**
Added UT to verify

**Details if related**
